purpose: Guide a HUMAN from an uploaded SAFOR bundle to a durable, resumable project without coupling SAFOR Memory to a specific source-control product.
stopRule: STOP only when a mandatory capability cannot be proven or the HUMAN declines a required authorization. Missing GitHub/GitLab alone is never a STOP reason.

sequence.title: Wo soll dein SAFOR Memory liegen?
sequence.rule: Discover only memory providers that can plausibly satisfy SAFOR Memory capabilities. Do not assume a provider is usable because its product is named or connected.

examples: Plastic SCM / Unity Version Control when a compatible connector exposes equivalent artifact/revision semantics

candidates.eligibility: Host must explicitly expose durable storage.

sequence.title: Welches Memory möchtest du verwenden?
sequence.rule: The HUMAN explicitly selects or approves one discovered memory provider. There is no silent default.

sequence.title: Memory prüfen
sequence.rule: Prove durable read/write/revision/resume semantics using actual host/provider evidence. A successful one-time file write is insufficient proof of persistence.

whenLocationMissing.rule: SAFOR may create a memory location only after the HUMAN approves its identity and scope. No silent creation.

sequence.stopMessage: Stopp. Ich habe noch keinen Speicher, den ich dauerhaft lesen, schreiben und in einer neuen Sitzung wiederfinden kann.

sequence.title: Wem gehört dieses Memory?
sequence.rule: The physical memory is controlled by the HUMAN or organization. SAFOR and the LLM receive access only.

sequence.title: Gemeinsames Arbeiten absichern
rules: PERSONAL requires the mandatory memory baseline and may use SINGLE_WRITER concurrency.
SHARED_TEAM additionally requires memory.shared_access and either memory.compare_and_swap or memory.lock.
If shared multi-writer safety cannot be proven, SHARED_TEAM is blocked; SAFOR may offer PERSONAL instead.

sequence.title: SAFOR Memory verbinden
sequence.rule: Bind the stable memory location, persist ownership/provider/concurrency metadata and read it back. The location name is provider-specific; `safor-memory` is a recommendation for repository-backed memory, not a universal requirement.

sequence.title: Was möchtest du erstellen?
sequence.rule: Exactly one creation type is mandatory. The selected Factory controls Discovery, Planning, Evidence and outcome semantics.

sequence.title: Wo liegen die Arbeitsartefakte?
sequence.rule: Work/SCM provider selection is independent from SAFOR Memory. Offer only providers whose actual host tools satisfy the bound Factory's workspace requirements. If the Factory declares workspaceRequirements.required=false, also offer MEMORY_ONLY.

sequence.title: Arbeitsumgebung prüfen
sequence.rule: If MEMORY_ONLY is selected and allowed by the bound Factory, no external work provider is required. Otherwise verify only the provider capabilities required by the selected Factory and intended operation.

sequence.title: Welches Projekt?
sequence.existingRule: List eligible workspaces from the selected work provider, using provider-specific activity metadata when available.
sequence.newRule: Creation requires explicit HUMAN confirmation plus actual create capability. Never create before confirmation.

sequence.title: Arbeitsmodell bestätigen
sequence.rule: Pin MEMORY_PROVIDER_ADAPTER, FACTORY, OPERATING_MODEL and required PROVIDER_ADAPTER packages. Creation type determines Factory/Operating Model; memory and work providers remain independently selected.

sequence.title: Projekt starten
sequence.rule: After explicit setup approval, persist project descriptor, bindings, memory binding and initial state in SAFOR Memory, register the current session and read everything back before initialization completes.

workProviderActivityNormalization.purpose: Normalize optional recent-workspace discovery across SCM providers.
workProviderActivityNormalization.rule: Use provider-native activity metadata when available. Lack of a normalized activity timestamp must not make an otherwise valid work provider unusable.

identityAndSecrets.rule: Use host/provider connection mechanisms. Actual permissions are evidence, not declarations in JSON.

stateAuthority.rule: Every decision or state change required by a later step must be persisted to SAFOR Memory before the later step may rely on it.
